answer: Make every agent sign a saffron charter before it can trade: a horizon pledge written in ink that deepens only when two unrelated witnesses co-sign a real job, so a fake identity cannot stamp its own history. Behind the charter sits a juniper twin-stake, one part released at a near horizon and the rest at a far one, both forfeited if a duplicate is found. Standing grows only as fresh saffron marks accumulate from new partners each epoch. Sybil farms must fund twin stakes, recruit fresh witnesses, and wait out two horizons for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
